subject: vt-dy
title: VT.DY.------POST.
description: Chart on book p. 453 (TRF(CW)-25). VT-DY (vibrational dynamics) is the subject; POST (postulation) is the partner. From the subject: TR (transformation), ATTN (attraction) and PART (participation). From TR: INFO-INTG (information integration). From INFO-INTG: C-INFO (composite information). From ATTN: INFO-DY. From INFO-DY: IST-PT (isolated particulars). From IST-PT: SF-RZ (self-realization). From PART: AF-DY (affinity dynamics).
